# Sessions, discovery and lifecycle (`sessions`)

Area `sessions` is owned by WP4-SESS; its contracts live in `src/contracts/areas/sessions.ts`.

## `bea_status` — BEA Status

Report BEA's own state without touching any target: server version and run id, which opt-in gates are enabled and how to enable them, fixed limits and quotas, backend availability (Frida binding and local device, jobhost, emulator bridge), and open sessions with their active instruments and effects. Call it first when a tool is unavailable.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects    | Gate | CLI                    |
| ----- | --------------------- | ---------- | ---- | ---------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | idempotent | —    | `bea status` (oneshot) |

Input: no fields.

Deadline 10,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence not recorded · sessions none · results carry untrusted target content.

## `list_processes` — List Processes

List local processes (pid, name, path, parent pid, start time, user) with an optional case-insensitive name filter, paged with a total. Host-side enumeration: never attaches or injects. Marks processes BEA already has a session on. Names and paths are target-controlled text. Only attach to a process the user named.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                    | Gate | CLI                         |
| ----- | --------------------- | -------------------------- | ---- | --------------------------- |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | `bea ps <filter>` (oneshot) |

| Input field | Type                 | Required | Default | Description                                     |
| ----------- | -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `filter`    | string ≤256          | no       | —       | Case-insensitive substring of the name or path. |
| `offset`    | integer 0..100000000 | no       | `0`     |                                                 |
| `limit`     | integer 1..500       | no       | `50`    |                                                 |

Deadline 15,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence not recorded · sessions none · results carry untrusted target content.

## `spawn_process` — Spawn Process

Launch a program as a BEA-owned target: created suspended inside a kill-on-close job (bea-jobhost), the BEA agent injected and ready-checked, then left PAUSED until resume_process so instruments can be installed before main runs. Returns session_id, identity (pid, start time, image sha256), main module and built-in recordings. close_session kills the whole job tree. Refuses 32-bit, protected and anti-cheat-guarded targets, and script interpreters or system tools unless the user allowed them. Max 4 live sessions, 3 capturing output.

| Phase | Hints      | Effects                                                      | Gate | CLI                                                             |
| ----- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P1    | open-world | injectsCode, suspendsTarget, launchesProcess, mutatesSession | —    | scenario-target: creates the session that scenario steps run in |

| Input field       | Type                                     | Required | Default | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `program`         | string ≤1024                             | yes      | —       | Absolute path of the .exe (not .bat/.cmd).                                                    |
| `args`            | array<string ≤8192> ≤256                 | no       | `[]`    |                                                                                               |
| `cwd`             | string ≤1024                             | no       | —       | Working directory; default: the program's directory.                                          |
| `capture_output`  | boolean                                  | no       | `true`  | false: inherit the server's handles (no output recording, not counted in the 3-piped cap).    |
| `env`             | array<string ≤8192 `^[^=\\s][^=]*=`> ≤64 | no       | `[]`    | KEY=VALUE entries added to the OS-allowlist environment; BEA_* keys are dropped.              |
| `expect_sha256`   | string `^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$`               | no       | —       | Expected sha256 of the image file (64 hex), e.g. from REA or Ghidra.                          |
| `redact_literals` | array<string ≤256> ≤32                   | no       | `[]`    | Session-wide sensitive strings (4..256 chars) redacted from evidence; only the count is kept. |

Deadline 60,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.process.instance` · sessions none · results carry untrusted target content.

## `attach_process` — Attach Process

Attach to a running process the user named (pid or exact image name) and inject the BEA agent (frida-agent.dll plus ~24 system DLLs; 11 stay loaded after detach). Returns session_id and identity (pid, start time, image path and sha256). BEA never kills an attached target: close_session reverts BEA's instruments and detaches. Refuses system, protected, other-user, 32-bit and anti-cheat-guarded processes. Pass expect_sha256 when you know the static image hash.

| Phase | Hints | Effects                     | Gate | CLI                                                             |
| ----- | ----- | --------------------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P1    | —     | injectsCode, mutatesSession | —    | scenario-target: creates the session that scenario steps run in |

| Input field       | Type                       | Required | Default | Description                                                                                   |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pid`             | integer 1..4294967295      | no       | —       |                                                                                               |
| `name`            | string ≤260                | no       | —       | Exact image file name, case-insensitive.                                                      |
| `expect_sha256`   | string `^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$` | no       | —       | Expected sha256 of the image file (64 hex), e.g. from REA or Ghidra.                          |
| `redact_literals` | array<string ≤256> ≤32     | no       | `[]`    | Session-wide sensitive strings (4..256 chars) redacted from evidence; only the count is kept. |

Deadline 60,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.process.instance` · sessions none · results carry untrusted target content.

## `resume_process` — Resume Process

Resume a paused BEA-spawned target so its own code runs (main has not executed before this). Optionally block up to wait_ms until the process exits or every active instrument finishes; returns exit code, crash report and finished instrument summaries. Running out of wait_ms is not an error. Refused for attached targets (already running) and while instrument cleanup is pending.

| Phase | Hints       | Effects                            | Gate | CLI                                                                                                          |
| ----- | ----------- | ---------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| P1    | destructive | executesTargetCode, mutatesSession | —    | scenario: Session state cannot cross CLI processes; use it from MCP or as a step of `bea run scenario.json`. |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                          |
| `wait_ms`    | integer 0..60000                                                        | no       | `0`     |                                                                                     |
| `until`      | "any" \| "exit" \| "instruments_done"                                   | no       | `"any"` | any: exit or every instrument active at call time finished; exit; instruments_done. |

Deadline 75,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.process.instance` · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.

## `session_status` — Session Status

Report one session: liveness, ownership and containment, exit code with NTSTATUS name, crash report (faulting instruction, module+RVA, registers, backtrace) if the target died, active instruments and effects with remaining lifetime, recordings with event and drop counts, scans, output tail and module-map epoch. Also works on closed sessions (final state). Never changes the target.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                    | Gate | CLI                                                                                                          |
| ----- | --------------------- | -------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| P1    | read-only, idempotent | mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | scenario: Session state cannot cross CLI processes; use it from MCP or as a step of `bea run scenario.json`. |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default     | Description                                                                     |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —           | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                      |
| `detail`     | "summary" \| "complete"                                                 | no       | `"summary"` | complete adds xmm registers to a crash and records bea.session.status evidence. |

Deadline 15,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence detail-complete as `bea.session.status` · sessions live, emulation · results carry untrusted target content.

## `close_session` — Close Session

End a session. Owned target: the whole job tree is killed first. Attached target: every BEA hook, watch, trace, override and write is reverted, the agent unloaded and the process detached and left running. Emulation: the emulator state is discarded. Recording manifests are finalized and evidence stays queryable. Reports per-effect revert status; a failed revert keeps the session for retry (effect_unreverted), and force:true detaches anyway. Closing a closed session returns its final state.

| Phase | Hints                   | Effects                                                     | Gate | CLI                                                                                                          |
| ----- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| P1    | destructive, idempotent | instrumentsTarget, killsProcess, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | scenario: Session state cannot cross CLI processes; use it from MCP or as a step of `bea run scenario.json`. |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default | Description                                                          |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —       | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.           |
| `force`      | boolean                                                                 | no       | `false` | Attached: continue past unreverted effects (reported revert-failed). |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence always as `bea.process.exit` · sessions live, emulation · results carry untrusted target content.
